group_description: Founded in 1999 at ICMUV, the UMDO group originally focused on the physics of low-dimensional semiconductors (quantum wells and dots), specifically their optical properties and exciton recombination dynamics. Today, UMDO+ has evolved to integrate new researchers and lines, expanding into 2D semiconductors (chalcogenides) and metal halide perovskites. Our research now spans from first-principles theory of electronic states to the fabrication of advanced optoelectronic devices, energy production via electrocatalysis, and quantum technologies for telecommunications. We combine physicochemical synthesis of thin films with advanced spectroscopic characterization to understand and develop linear/nonlinear optical, electrical, and magnetic properties.
